messages:
Maria (AE): quick sync — Acme wants a tightly scoped 4-week POC. Core ask: answer extraction + confidence scoring for customer support docs. Need to align acceptance criteria and handoff plan.
Ben (SE): noted. My proposal: week 0 prep, week 1 ingest + prompt tuning, week 2 evals, week 3 latency/scale test, week 4 acceptance & handoff. Who owns infra?
Priya (PM): timeline works. We need SE support days: 3 days week1, 2 days week2, 1 day week4 for handoff. Also require an eval prompt set (30 queries) + golden labels.
Daniel (SalesOps): pricing question — customer asked if we include 2 hours per week of SE time in POC or bill separately. What's standard?
Maria (AE): usually include 8-12 hrs of SE for discovery and tuning in the POC package. For additional deep integrations we upsell. Call out in SOW.
Ben (SE): can do 12h total in scope. If they want data connector work (on-prem S3), that'll be a separate ticket.
Acme IT (customer): @Maria confirming: we can provide a subset of support articles (S3 URL) and a test user for SSO. Golden labels team can deliver 40 labeled Q/A by day -5.
Priya (PM): perfect. Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Precision@10 >= 85% on labeled set
- Average 95th pct latency per query < 600ms (off-peak)
- No PII leaked in 3 random audits
- Handback doc + runbook delivered week4
```
Ben (SE): small tweak: latency target depends on model/quant. I'll add target variants (hosted vs dedicated). Also need to validate tokenization for doc types.
Maria (AE): action items: 1) Acme to share S3 + labels by EOD Wed; 2) Ben to draft prompt set + eval harness by Fri; 3) Priya to update SOW with included 12h SE and pricing delta for connector.
Daniel (SalesOps): I'll prepare a PO/quote appendix for the connector add-on. Maria — shall I cc legal for the data access section?
Maria (AE): yes, cc legal. Also include KMS requirement (customer asked).
Ben (SE): Will schedule two 60m workshop sessions week0 to align prompts and data schema. Sending calendar invite.
staging-bot: ingest job created: job_id=ingest-20230720-88, status=queued
Priya (PM): risk note: if labels come late we shift week2 evals and compress handoff week. Keep customer aware.
Acme IT (customer): acknowledged. We'll aim for EOD Wed. Any change to acceptance criteria please flag now.
Maria (AE): thanks everyone — I'll update the SOW and follow up with a one-pager acceptance checklist for the customer. :thumbsup:
